title: Stop-losses for short options
summary: The day-15 stop-loss, why missed stop-losses end accounts, and the profit and time exits.

questions.q: When does the app's stop-loss start working on a short leg?
questions.why: No stop-loss for the first 15 days, then buy back at the original premium.

questions.q: From day 15, the stop-loss buys the option back when its price reaches:
questions.why: It exits at the premium you sold for, about breakeven on that leg.

questions.q: You sold at ₹8 and the option is now ₹40. The loss is how many times the premium?
Averaging down on a losing short option means:
options: Selling more of it, which increases risk at the worst time
questions.why: Adding to a loser doubles exposure exactly when the position is going wrong.

questions.q: Why does the app close a group once 90% of the premium has decayed?
options: The last 10% isn't worth holding the full risk for
questions.why: Almost all the reward is already booked while the risk is still there.
